description:
"Juicy" is the lead single from the 1994 debut album Ready to Die by The Notorious B.I.G. The track's production is built around a sample of the 1983 song "Juicy Fruit" by Mtume. The single reached No. 27 on the Billboard Hot 100. The autobiographical lyrics of The Notorious B.I.G. describe his past struggles and subsequent success in the hip hop industry.

Directed by: Sean “Puffy” Combs

The Notorious B.I.G., also known as Biggie Smalls or Biggie, was an American rapper and songwriter. His debut album Ready to Die (1994) reached multi-platinum status and included singles such as Juicy, Big Poppa, and One More Chance. His second album Life After Death (1997) was released posthumously, achieved diamond certification, and produced two Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 singles: Hypnotize and Mo Money Mo Problems. He received multiple Grammy Award nominations during his career.
